stagedEvidenceWhitespace.disposition: The exact original GPT report uses intentional Markdown hard breaks; the correction packet contains exact diff-context and numbered blank source lines. Per-file Git attributes disable only the end-of-line whitespace rule for those two evidence copies, preserving the original report bytes and exact packet content. All other staged paths retain normal checks.

limits: These are pre-integration local checks, not immutable published ZIP, remote CI, native acceptance or correction review. Full path-bearing logs and command receipt remain local by hash. Whitespace for new evidence files is checked after staging.
